scope: Shipped files and runtime map resources containing, displaying, or derived from OpenStreetMap data.

license.name: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0
license.classification_policy: Only geometry and boundary data evidenced as OSM-derived is classified odbl. Files that combine OSM geometry with contractual, association, or other sources are classified mixed; this ledger does not assert that non-OSM fields are ODbL-covered.

runtime.tile_access: Viewport-driven Leaflet requests only; no prefetch, bulk download, or offline-area fill.
runtime.referer_policy: The browser supplies the site Referer; the application does not forge or suppress it.
runtime.cache_policy: Viewed tiles only, HTTP cache semantics plus a maximum seven-day service-worker retention window; server Cache-Control is not overridden.
